summary: First Majestic Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K with its Q2 2026 unaudited financial results and a quarterly dividend declaration. The filing reports production increases (silver +3%, gold +2% YoY), revenue up 57% to $415.5 million, net earnings of $109.4 million ($0.22 EPS), and record treasury of $1,252.7 million, up 34% from end-2025. Free cash flow reached $194.6 million. No mergers, acquisitions, buybacks, or other special-situations transactions are announced. This is a routine earnings disclosure and dividend update, not a transformative corporate event.
